tool.name: ccnv reference
tool.description: Build a germline or prenatal CNV reference model from control samples or FASTA
tool.command: #if $source_cond.source_type == "cohort_collection": mkdir -p samples && #for $i, $s in enumerate($source_cond.samples): ln -s '$s' 'samples/sample_${i}.ccnv' && #end for cat > samplesheet.json <<'EOF' && [ #for $i, $s in enumerate($source_cond.samples): #set $comma = "," if $i < len($source_cond.samples) - 1 else "" {"filepath": "samples/sample_${i}.ccnv"}$comma #end for ] EOF #elif $source_cond.source_type == "cohort_annotated": mkdir -p samples && #for $i, $entry in enumerate($source_cond.entries): ln -s '${entry.sample}' 'samples/sample_${i}.ccnv' && #end for cat > samplesheet.json <<'EOF' && [ #for $i, $entry in enumerate($source_cond.entries): #set $comma = "," if $i < len($source_cond.entries) - 1 else "" #set $sex_json = '"' + str($entry.sex) + '"' if str($entry.sex) in ("M", "F") else "null" #set $ff_json = str($entry.ff) if str($entry.ff) not in ("", "None") else "null" {"filepath": "samples/sample_${i}.ccnv", "sex": $sex_json, "ff": $ff_json}$comma #end for ] EOF #elif $source_cond.source_type == "flat_fasta": #if $source_cond.fasta_source.fasta_select == "cached": ln -s '$source_cond.fasta_source.fasta_cached.fields.path' reference.fa && if [ -e '${source_cond.fasta_source.fasta_cached.fields.path}.fai' ]; then ln -s '${source_cond.fasta_source.fasta_cached.fields.path}.fai' reference.fa.fai; fi && #else: ln -s '$source_cond.fasta_source.fasta_history' reference.fa && #end if #end if @STAGE_COVARIATE_TRACKS@ ccnv reference --prefix out_ref #if $source_cond.source_type != "flat_fasta": --samplesheet samplesheet.json #else: --fasta reference.fa $source_cond.all_contigs #end if --mode '$mode_cond.mode' #if $mode_cond.mode == "prenatal": --prenatal-binsize '$mode_cond.prenatal_binsize' #end if --bin-size '$bin_size' #if str($contigs.autosomal_contig).strip(): #for $contig in str($contigs.autosomal_contig).replace(",", " ").split(): --autosomal-contig '$contig' #end for #end if #if str($contigs.sex_contig).strip(): #for $contig in str($contigs.sex_contig).replace(",", " ").split(): --sex-contig '$contig' #end for #end if #if str($contigs.sex_signal_contig).strip(): --sex-signal-contig '$contigs.sex_signal_contig' #end if #if str($contigs.sex_cutoff) not in ("", "None"): --sex-cutoff '$contigs.sex_cutoff' #end if #if str($advanced.pca_components) not in ("", "None"): --pca-components '$advanced.pca_components' #end if --max-batch-memory-mb '$advanced.max_batch_memory_mb' --min-cohort-size '$advanced.min_cohort_size' --min-sex-group-size '$advanced.min_sex_group_size' $advanced.qc_report @COVARIATE_ARGS@ --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --loglevel '$loglevel'

param.name: source_type
param.label: Reference source
param.option: Control samples with per-sample sex / fetal fraction annotations
Flat uniform-depth reference from FASTA (germline only)

param.name: samples
param.label: Control sample Parquet files (.ccnv)
param.help: Normal control sample Parquet files extracted by ccnv extract.

param.name: sex
param.label: Known sample or fetal sex
param.help: Leave automatic to infer sex from X/Y coverage dosage.

param.name: ff
param.label: Known fetal fraction (optional, [0, 1])
param.help: Optional known fetal fraction for prenatal calibration.

param.label: Include all FASTA contigs
param.help: Include non-canonical contigs when building a flat reference.

param.label: Prenatal coarse bin size (bp)
param.help: Target bin size for coarsening autosomal and chrX counts for FFA and FFX models.

param.label: Target bin size (bp)
param.help: Primary bin width for the reference model. Compatible sample Parquets are rebinned in memory if needed.

param.label: Sex signal contig (optional)
param.help: Contig used to infer sample sex (default: chrY/Y).

param.label: Sex signal coverage cutoff (optional)
param.help: Coverage fraction threshold on the sex signal contig above which samples are classified as male.

param.label: Maximum PCA components (optional)
param.help: Cap PCA rank per branch; leave empty to use automatic Gavish-Donoho SVHT rank selection.

param.label: Max batch memory (MiB)
param.help: Memory cap before cohort matrices spill to temporary memory-mapped arrays.

param.label: Minimum cohort size
param.help: Minimum samples required to fit the autosomal branch.

param.label: Minimum sex group size
param.help: Minimum samples per sex required to fit a sex-specific branch.

tool.help:
**What it does**
``ccnv reference`` builds a reusable Schema v2.0.0 CNV reference model (``.ccnv``) from a cohort of control sample Parquets or a flat reference FASTA (germline mode only).
In cohort mode, it performs 1 Mb super-block DESeq2 depth scaling, optional GC/mappability/fragmentomic Poisson bias regression, sex inference and outlier quarantine, Gavish-Donoho SVHT PCA denoising, off-chromosome Prototype Graph construction, and Smyth Empirical Bayes biological overdispersion shrinkage. In ``prenatal`` mode, it additionally fits closed-form Poisson MSY ``FFY``, 100 kb ``FFA`` and ``FFX`` regressions, fetal/maternal fragment-length density deconvolution, 24-band Fisher read weights, and the 36-feature ``FF_size`` ensemble.
**Outputs**
- **Reference Parquet (.ccnv)**: Reusable cohort or flat FASTA reference model. - **Reference QC JSON**: Diagnostic quality metrics and branch usability verdicts (emitted when ``--qc-report`` is enabled).
